blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解為何需要開發增強型封蓋檢測方法 (Enhanced Closures Testing Method)，以及它如何整合 USP <788> 與 ISO 8871-3 的現有方法
blocks.en: Understand why an Enhanced Closures Testing Method is needed and how it integrates the existing methods of USP <788> and ISO 8871-3

blocks.zh: 掌握可見微粒 (Visible Particle) 與亞可見微粒 (Subvisible Particle) 的分類邏輯，特別是 100 μm 與 300 μm 的尺寸閾值
blocks.en: Grasp the classification logic for visible versus subvisible particles, especially the 100 μm and 300 μm size thresholds

blocks.zh: 了解新型顯微鏡標線片 (Reticle) 的設計原理及其如何實現快速、一致的微粒分類
blocks.en: Understand the design principle of the new microscope reticle and how it enables fast, consistent particle classification

blocks.zh: 認識方法確認 (Method Qualification) 過程中遇到的變異性挑戰與關鍵經驗教訓
blocks.en: Become familiar with the variability challenges encountered during method qualification and the key lessons learned

blocks.zh: 4.0 Elastomeric Closures Test Method 4.0 彈性體封蓋測試方法
blocks.en: 4.0 Elastomeric Closures Test Method

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Enhanced Closures Testing Method (增強型封蓋檢測方法): 這是 TR85 的核心貢獻 -- 一套全新的標準化方法，專門用於量化彈性體封蓋上的可見微粒負載。它融合了 USP <788> Method 2（美國藥典的微粒檢測方法）與 ISO 8871-3（國際標準化組織針對彈性體封蓋的規範）的優勢。
blocks.en: Enhanced Closures Testing Method: This is the core contribution of TR85: a new standardized method designed specifically to quantify the visible particle burden on elastomeric closures. It combines the strengths of USP <788> Method 2 (the USP particle test method) and ISO 8871-3 (the International Organization for Standardization specification for elastomeric closures).

blocks.zh: Elastomeric Closures (彈性體封蓋): 指用於密封注射劑容器的橡膠塞（如膠塞、活塞等），是容器密封系統 (Container-Closure System) 的關鍵組成部分。
blocks.en: Elastomeric Closures: Rubber closures used to seal injectable containers (such as stoppers and plungers); a key component of the container-closure system.

blocks.zh: 關鍵重點：測試必須在封蓋收集到最終包裝後進行，這確保了結果能真實反映藥廠實際收到的產品狀態。
blocks.en: Key point: Testing must be performed after the closures have been collected in their final packaging, which ensures that the results truly reflect the condition of the product as actually received by the pharmaceutical company.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你和供應商各自用不同的秤來衡量蔬菜重量 -- 你用彈簧秤，他用電子秤，結果總是對不上。TR85 做的事情就像制定一套「統一的秤和稱重步驟」，讓買賣雙方（藥廠和橡膠塞供應商）都用同一把尺來衡量微粒，這樣比較數據才有意義。
blocks.en: Imagine that you and a supplier each weigh vegetables on a different scale, you with a spring scale and the supplier with an electronic scale, and the numbers never match. What TR85 does is like establishing a "unified scale and weighing procedure", so that both buyer and seller (the pharmaceutical company and the rubber stopper supplier) measure particles with the same ruler and the comparison of data becomes meaningful.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 為什麼現有方法不夠用？因為 USP <788> 和 ISO 8871-3 各有側重點，且沒有專門針對「可見微粒」的分類機制。在 CDMO 環境中，藥廠和封蓋供應商之間的數據不一致是常見的品質爭議來源。標準化的方法可以大幅減少這類溝通成本。
blocks.en: Why are existing methods not enough? Because USP <788> and ISO 8871-3 each have their own emphasis, and neither has a classification mechanism specifically for "visible particles". In a CDMO environment, inconsistent data between the pharmaceutical company and the closure supplier is a common source of quality disputes. A standardized method can greatly reduce this communication cost.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR85 要求在「最終包裝後」對封蓋進行微粒測試，而不是在生產線上立即測試？
blocks.en: Why does TR85 require particle testing of closures "after final packaging" rather than immediately on the production line?

blocks.zh: 如果藥廠和供應商使用不同的微粒檢測方法，可能會導致哪些商業和品質風險？
blocks.en: If a pharmaceutical company and its supplier use different particle test methods, what commercial and quality risks could result?

blocks.zh: 4.1 Enhanced Closures Testing Method Development 4.1 強化封蓋測試方法開發
blocks.en: 4.1 Enhanced Closures Testing Method Development

blocks.zh: Visible vs. Subvisible Particles (可見微粒 vs. 亞可見微粒): 這是注射劑品質管控的核心分類。法規上的「可見」定義非常具體：在控制照明條件下，合格檢查員肉眼在約 10 秒內於黑白背景前能看到的就是「可見」。
blocks.en: Visible vs. Subvisible Particles: This is the core classification in injectable quality control. The regulatory definition of "visible" is very specific: what a qualified inspector can see with the unaided eye in about 10 seconds against a black and white background under controlled lighting is "visible".

blocks.zh: USP <790> (美國藥典第 790 章): 專門規範成品注射劑中可見微粒的標準，要求產品「基本上無可見微粒」(essentially free)。
blocks.en: USP <790> (USP Chapter 790): Specifically sets the standard for visible particles in finished injectable products, requiring the product to be "essentially free" of visible particles.

blocks.zh: AVI Systems (自動目視檢查系統): Automated Visual Inspection 的縮寫，使用機器視覺來檢測容器中的微粒，其檢測能力通常超越人眼。
blocks.en: AVI Systems (automated visual inspection systems): AVI stands for Automated Visual Inspection; these systems use machine vision to detect particles in containers, and their detection capability generally exceeds that of the human eye.

blocks.zh: 這就像安檢場景的差異：肉眼安檢就是保安目視檢查你的行李，而用顯微鏡就像過 X 光機 -- X 光機能看到人眼看不到的東西（如隱藏在衣物夾層裡的小物件）。問題是，X 光機「太靈敏了」，連不需要擔心的東西也標記出來。所以我們需要一個規則來判斷：X 光機發現的東西，哪些算「真正的問題」，哪些只是「無關緊要的小東西」。
blocks.en: This is like the difference in security screening: eye inspection is a guard looking at your luggage, while using a microscope is like going through an X-ray machine, which can see things the human eye cannot (such as small objects hidden in the lining of clothing). The problem is that the X-ray machine is "too sensitive" and flags even things that do not need to be worried about. So we need a rule to decide which of the things the X-ray machine finds count as "real problems" and which are merely "insignificant little things".

blocks.zh: 核心挑戰：當分析方法的靈敏度超過人眼時，它會同時偵測到可見和亞可見微粒，無法區分兩者。這不僅是顯微鏡的問題，也是所有高靈敏度方法（AVI、AI 應用等）共有的挑戰。TR85 引入尺寸閾值來解決這個分類困境。
blocks.en: Core challenge: When an analytical method is more sensitive than the human eye, it detects both visible and subvisible particles and cannot distinguish between them. This is not only a problem of the microscope but a challenge shared by all highly sensitive methods (AVI, AI applications, etc.). TR85 introduces size thresholds to resolve this classification dilemma.

blocks.zh: 供應商 vs. 藥廠雙重測試：封蓋供應商在出貨時測試，藥廠在進貨時也測試。兩邊必須用一致的方法和標準，否則會出現數據矛盾。
blocks.en: Dual testing by supplier and pharmaceutical company: The closure supplier tests at shipment and the pharmaceutical company also tests at receipt. Both sides must use consistent methods and standards, otherwise contradictory data will arise.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 日常運營中，進料品質管控 (Incoming QC) 經常會遇到供應商數據與自己實驗室數據不一致的情況。如果雙方都採用 TR85 的增強型方法作為共同標準，可以在供應商品質協議 (Quality Agreement) 中明確約定方法細節，大幅減少爭議和退貨。
blocks.en: In daily CDMO operations, incoming quality control (Incoming QC) often runs into cases where the supplier's data and the company's own laboratory data do not agree. If both sides adopt the TR85 Enhanced method as a common standard, the method details can be explicitly agreed in the supplier Quality Agreement, greatly reducing disputes and returns.

blocks.zh: 顯微鏡檢查為何會「混淆」可見與亞可見微粒的分類？能否舉一個具體例子？
blocks.en: Why can microscopy "confuse" the classification of visible and subvisible particles? Can you give a specific example?

blocks.zh: 除了顯微鏡，文中還提到哪些同樣面臨「靈敏度超越人眼」挑戰的檢測方法？
blocks.en: Besides microscopy, which other detection methods mentioned in the text face the same challenge of "sensitivity exceeding the human eye"?

blocks.zh: 4.1.1 Size Threshold 4.1.1 尺寸閾值
blocks.en: 4.1.1 Size Threshold

blocks.zh: Size Threshold (尺寸閾值): 當使用超越人眼能力的分析方法時，用來界定「可見」與「亞可見」的數值界線。
blocks.en: Size Threshold: The numerical boundary used to separate "visible" from "subvisible" when an analytical method that exceeds the capability of the human eye is used.

blocks.zh: 等軸微粒 (Equant Particle): 長寬比 <5 的微粒 -- 閾值為 100 μm
blocks.en: Equant Particle: A particle with an aspect ratio <5; the threshold is 100 μm

blocks.zh: 纖維狀微粒 (Fiber): 長寬比 ≥5 的微粒 -- 閾值為 300 μm
blocks.en: Fiber: A particle with an aspect ratio ≥5; the threshold is 300 μm

blocks.zh: PoD (Probability of Detection, 檢出機率): 衡量檢查員在標準條件下能偵測到某一大小微粒的機率。研究顯示 150 μm 球形微粒的平均 PoD >70%，而 50 μm 幾乎無法被偵測到。
blocks.en: PoD (Probability of Detection): A measure of the probability that an inspector can detect a particle of a given size under standard conditions. Studies show that the average PoD for a 150 μm spherical particle is >70%, while a 50 μm particle is almost undetectable.

blocks.zh: Aspect Ratio (長寬比): 微粒的長度與寬度之比。球形微粒約為 1:1，纖維可能是 10:1 或更高。長寬比決定了微粒的二維投影面積，直接影響可見性。
blocks.en: Aspect Ratio: The ratio of a particle's length to its width. A spherical particle is about 1:1, while a fiber may be 10:1 or higher. The aspect ratio determines the particle's two-dimensional projected area, which directly affects visibility.

blocks.zh: 想像你站在三樓窗戶往下看地面上的物品：一顆直徑 1 公分的彈珠你很容易看到（等軸微粒），但一根同樣 1 公分長、只有 1 毫米粗的牙籤就很難看到（纖維狀微粒）。為什麼？因為彈珠的「正面投影面積」比牙籤大得多。這就是為什麼纖維狀微粒需要 300 μm（比等軸的 100 μm 長 3 倍）才算「可見」。
blocks.en: Imagine standing at a third-floor window looking down at objects on the ground: a marble 1 cm in diameter is easy to see (an equant particle), but a toothpick the same 1 cm long and only 1 mm thick is hard to see (a fiber). Why? Because the marble's "frontal projected area" is much larger than the toothpick's. This is why a fiber must be 300 μm (3 times longer than the equant 100 μm) to count as "visible".

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh: 纖維閾值的推導邏輯：
blocks.en: Derivation logic of the fiber threshold:

blocks.zh:
150 μm 球體的二維面積 = π × (75)² ≈ 17,671 μm²

纖維（長寬比 5:1）：面積 = 長度 × 寬度 = L × (L/5)
設等面積：L²/5 = 17,671
L = √(17,671 × 5) ≈ 297 μm → 取整為 300 μm

100 μm 球體 vs. 100 μm 纖維（10:1）：
球體面積 = π × (50)² ≈ 7,854 μm²
纖維面積 = 100 × 10 = 1,000 μm²
比值 ≈ 7.85 倍 → 文中說「nearly eight times」
blocks.en:
2D area of a 150 μm sphere = π × (75)² ≈ 17,671 μm²

Fiber (aspect ratio 5:1): area = length × width = L × (L/5)
Setting equal areas: L²/5 = 17,671
L = √(17,671 × 5) ≈ 297 μm → rounded to 300 μm

100 μm sphere vs. 100 μm fiber (10:1):
Sphere area = π × (50)² ≈ 7,854 μm²
Fiber area = 100 × 10 = 1,000 μm²
Ratio ≈ 7.85 times → the text says "nearly eight times"

blocks.zh: 100 μm 是保守值：研究顯示 150 μm 才是可靠檢出的下限（PoD >70%），但 TR85 選擇了更低的 100 μm 作為閾值。這是「寧可多抓，不可漏放」的保守策略 -- 確保即使在最佳檢測條件下才勉強可見的微粒，也被歸類為「可見」。
blocks.en: 100 μm is a conservative value: Studies show that 150 μm is the lower limit for reliable detection (PoD >70%), but TR85 chose the lower value of 100 μm as the threshold. This is a conservative "better to catch too many than to miss any" strategy: it ensures that even particles that are only barely visible under the best inspection conditions are classified as "visible".

blocks.zh: 適用範圍的嚴格限制：
blocks.en: Strict limits on scope of application:

blocks.zh: 這些閾值僅適用於使用超越人眼的分析方法測試包裝組件時
blocks.en: These thresholds apply only when testing packaging components with analytical methods that exceed the capability of the human eye

blocks.zh: 不適用於成品容器的最終目視檢查（那仍以人眼為標準）
blocks.en: They do not apply to final visual inspection of finished product containers (which still uses the human eye as the standard)

blocks.zh: 如果肉眼已經看到微粒，就直接歸類為「可見」，不需要再用閾值判斷
blocks.en: If a particle has already been seen with the naked eye, it is classified directly as "visible" and no threshold needs to be applied

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Table Analysis
blocks.en: Table Analysis

blocks.zh: Table 4.1.1-1 解讀：這張表是整個方法的核心參考工具。
blocks.en: Interpretation of Table 4.1.1-1: This table is the core reference tool of the whole method.

blocks.zh: 第一行（Particle）：形狀接近球形或塊狀（長寬比 <5）的微粒，只要 ≥100 μm 就算「可見」
blocks.en: First row (Particle): A particle that is close to spherical or blocky (aspect ratio <5) is "visible" as long as it is ≥100 μm

blocks.zh: 第二行（Fiber）：纖維狀（長寬比 ≥5）的微粒，需要 ≥300 μm 才算「可見」
blocks.en: Second row (Fiber): A fibrous particle (aspect ratio ≥5) must be ≥300 μm to count as "visible"

blocks.zh: 設計兩個閾值而非一個，體現了對微粒幾何形態影響可見性的科學理解
blocks.en: Having two thresholds rather than one reflects a scientific understanding of how particle geometry affects visibility

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的進料品質管控中，當顯微鏡檢查發現一個 120 μm 的塊狀微粒和一個 250 μm 的纖維狀微粒時：
blocks.en: In CDMO incoming quality control, when microscopy finds a 120 μm blocky particle and a 250 μm fibrous particle:

blocks.zh: 120 μm 塊狀微粒（長寬比 <5）：≥100 μm 閾值 -- 歸類為可見
blocks.en: 120 μm blocky particle (aspect ratio <5): ≥100 μm threshold -- classified as visible

blocks.zh: 250 μm 纖維（長寬比 ≥5）：<300 μm 閾值 -- 歸類為亞可見
blocks.en: 250 μm fiber (aspect ratio ≥5): <300 μm threshold -- classified as subvisible

blocks.zh: 注意：同一批膠塞可能同時含有兩種形態的微粒，需分別計數。
blocks.en: Note: The same batch of stoppers may contain both morphologies of particle, which must be counted separately.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 100 μm 閾值被認為是「保守的」？如果選擇 150 μm 作為閾值，會有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why is the 100 μm threshold considered "conservative"? What would be the effect if 150 μm were chosen as the threshold?

blocks.zh: 一個長寬比為 4.9 的微粒和一個長寬比為 5.1 的微粒，兩者的分類邏輯有何不同？
blocks.en: How does the classification logic differ for a particle with an aspect ratio of 4.9 and one with an aspect ratio of 5.1?

blocks.zh: 文中提到成品容器檢查不適用這些閾值。為什麼？成品檢查有哪些「干擾因素」是組件測試所沒有的？
blocks.en: The text says these thresholds do not apply to finished product container inspection. Why? What "interfering factors" are present in finished product inspection that are absent in component testing?

blocks.zh: 4.1.2 Novel Particle Size Measurement Tool 4.1.2 新型微粒粒徑量測工具
blocks.en: 4.1.2 Novel Particle Size Measurement Tool

blocks.zh: Reticle (標線片/十字絲): 安裝在顯微鏡目鏡中的光學輔助工具，上面刻有特定形狀和尺寸的參考圖案。分析人員透過目鏡觀察時，可以直接將微粒與標線片上的形狀做比較，不需要額外測量。
blocks.en: Reticle: An optical aid installed in the microscope eyepiece, engraved with reference patterns of specific shapes and sizes. When looking through the eyepiece, the analyst can compare the particle directly with the shapes on the reticle without any additional measurement.

blocks.zh: TR85 標線片設計的兩個形狀：
blocks.en: The two shapes in the TR85 reticle design:

blocks.zh: 圓形 (Circle): 直徑等於 100 μm -- 用於判定等軸微粒
blocks.en: Circle: Diameter equal to 100 μm -- used to classify equant particles

blocks.zh: 長方形 (Rectangle): 300 μm × 60 μm -- 用於判定纖維狀微粒（長寬比 5:1）
blocks.en: Rectangle: 300 μm × 60 μm -- used to classify fibrous particles (aspect ratio 5:1)

blocks.zh: 判定規則：微粒能完全放入任一形狀內 = 亞可見（不計數）；超出任一形狀邊界 = 可見（計數）。
blocks.en: Classification rule: A particle that fits entirely within either shape = subvisible (not counted); a particle that extends beyond the boundary of either shape = visible (counted).

blocks.zh: 這就像手機螢幕上的「護照照片裁切框」-- 你把臉對準框，如果臉完全在框內就合格，如果超出框就不合格。TR85 的標線片用同樣的概念：把微粒「對準」圓形或長方形的模板，看它是否超出邊界。這個設計的巧妙之處在於，分析人員不需要精確測量每個微粒的尺寸，只需做「比大小」的直覺判斷，大幅提高了效率和一致性。
blocks.en: This is like the "passport photo crop frame" on a phone screen: you line your face up with the frame, and if the face is entirely within the frame it passes, and if it extends beyond the frame it fails. The TR85 reticle uses the same concept: the particle is "lined up" against a circular or rectangular template to see whether it extends beyond the boundary. The clever part of this design is that the analyst does not need to measure the size of each particle precisely, only make an intuitive "bigger or smaller" judgment, which greatly improves efficiency and consistency.

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Figure Analysis
blocks.en: Figure Analysis

blocks.zh: Figure 4.1.2-1 解讀：
blocks.en: Interpretation of Figure 4.1.2-1:

blocks.zh: 圓形模板：直徑 100 μm，對應 Table 4.1.1-1 中等軸微粒的閾值。任何無法完全放入此圓形的等軸微粒（長寬比 <5）就是「可見微粒」
blocks.en: Circular template: Diameter 100 μm, corresponding to the equant particle threshold in Table 4.1.1-1. Any equant particle (aspect ratio <5) that cannot fit entirely within this circle is a "visible particle"

blocks.zh: 長方形模板：300 μm × 60 μm，對應纖維狀微粒的閾值。長方形的長寬比恰好是 5:1，完美呼應 Table 4.1.1-1 中纖維的閾值定義
blocks.en: Rectangular template: 300 μm × 60 μm, corresponding to the fiber threshold. The aspect ratio of the rectangle is exactly 5:1, matching the fiber threshold definition in Table 4.1.1-1

blocks.zh: 兩個形狀的巧妙設計讓分析人員可以在一次觀察中同時評估兩種幾何形態的微粒
blocks.en: The clever design of the two shapes lets the analyst evaluate both particle geometries in a single observation

blocks.zh: 為何這是一個重要的創新？傳統顯微鏡計數需要分析人員逐一測量每個微粒的尺寸，既耗時又容易產生人為誤差。TR85 的標線片設計將「測量」簡化為「比較」，帶來三大優勢：
blocks.en: Why is this an important innovation? Traditional microscope counting requires the analyst to measure the size of each particle one by one, which is time-consuming and prone to human error. The TR85 reticle design simplifies "measuring" to "comparing", bringing three major advantages:

blocks.zh: 速度：不需要每個微粒都做精確測量
blocks.en: Speed: No precise measurement of each particle is needed

blocks.zh: 一致性：不同分析人員看到同一個微粒，用同一個模板比較，得到相同結論
blocks.en: Consistency: Different analysts looking at the same particle and comparing it with the same template reach the same conclusion

blocks.zh: 可訓練性：新手只需學會「比大小」的操作，降低了技能門檻
blocks.en: Trainability: A newcomer only needs to learn the "compare sizes" operation, lowering the skill barrier

blocks.zh: 為什麼長方形模板的寬度是 60 μm 而不是其他數值？（提示：300 μm ÷ 5 = ?）
blocks.en: Why is the width of the rectangular template 60 μm and not some other value? (Hint: 300 μm ÷ 5 = ?)

blocks.zh: 如果一個微粒能完全放入長方形但超出圓形，它應該如何分類？為什麼？
blocks.en: If a particle fits entirely within the rectangle but extends beyond the circle, how should it be classified? Why?

blocks.zh: 標線片的校準需要注意哪些因素？（想想不同放大倍率的影響）
blocks.en: What factors need attention in calibrating the reticle? (Think about the effect of different magnifications.)

blocks.zh: 4.2 Summary for Performing the Enhanced Closures Testing Method 4.2 執行強化封蓋測試方法之摘要
blocks.en: 4.2 Summary for Performing the Enhanced Closures Testing Method

blocks.zh: 方法步驟摘要：
blocks.en: Summary of method steps:

blocks.zh: 取樣：按表面積標準化數量的封蓋放入錐形瓶 (Erlenmeyer Flask)
blocks.en: Sampling: Place a surface-area-normalized quantity of closures into an Erlenmeyer flask

blocks.zh: 沖洗：加入 50 mL 界面活性劑溶液 (Surfactant Solution)
blocks.en: Rinsing: Add 50 mL of surfactant solution

blocks.zh: 振盪：放在軌道式搖盪器 (Orbital Shaker) 上振盪 20 秒，將表面微粒剝離
blocks.en: Shaking: Shake on an orbital shaker for 20 seconds to dislodge surface particles

blocks.zh: 過濾：立即將沖洗液通過灰色膜過濾器 (Membrane Filter) 過濾
blocks.en: Filtration: Immediately filter the rinse solution through a gray membrane filter

blocks.zh: 重複：重複沖洗過程
blocks.en: Repeat: Repeat the rinsing process

blocks.zh: 乾燥：讓過濾器乾燥
blocks.en: Drying: Allow the filter to dry

blocks.zh: 計數：使用專用標線片和光學體視顯微鏡 (Optical Stereomicroscope) 計數可見微粒
blocks.en: Counting: Count the visible particles using the dedicated reticle and an optical stereomicroscope

blocks.zh: 整個流程就像洗衣服然後檢查洗出來的髒東西：把膠塞（衣服）放進瓶子（洗衣機），加入界面活性劑（洗衣液），搖晃 20 秒（洗滌），然後把洗出來的水過濾（排水過濾），看濾網上留下了什麼東西。灰色濾膜的選擇特別聰明 -- 就像用灰色桌布來觀察灰塵，淺色和深色的微粒都能看清楚。
blocks.en: The whole procedure is like washing clothes and then examining the dirt that came out: put the stoppers (clothes) into the flask (washing machine), add surfactant (detergent), shake for 20 seconds (wash), then filter the wash water (drain and filter) and see what is left on the filter. The choice of a gray membrane is especially clever: like using a gray tablecloth to look at dust, both light and dark particles can be seen clearly.

blocks.zh: 幾個關鍵的方法設計細節：
blocks.en: Some key method design details:

blocks.zh: 表面積標準化：不同尺寸的封蓋測試數量不同，以確保比較的公平性
blocks.en: Surface-area normalization: Closures of different sizes are tested in different quantities, to keep the comparison fair

blocks.zh: 灰色膜過濾器：刻意選擇灰色而非白色或黑色，因為灰色背景能同時提升淺色和深色微粒的對比度
blocks.en: Gray membrane filter: Gray was chosen deliberately over white or black, because a gray background improves the contrast of both light and dark particles

blocks.zh: 20 秒振盪：這個時間經過優化 -- 太短可能無法完全剝離微粒，太長可能破碎微粒導致計數不準
blocks.en: 20-second shaking: This time was optimized: too short may not dislodge the particles completely, too long may break up particles and make the count inaccurate

blocks.zh: 立即過濾：振盪後必須馬上過濾，避免微粒重新沉積回封蓋表面
blocks.en: Immediate filtration: Filtration must follow immediately after shaking, to prevent particles from redepositing on the closure surface

blocks.zh: 重複沖洗：做兩次確保充分回收
blocks.en: Repeat rinse: Done twice to ensure adequate recovery

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 實驗室導入此方法時，需要注意的實務考量：
blocks.en: Practical considerations when implementing this method in a CDMO laboratory:

blocks.zh: 設備需求：軌道式搖盪器（需可設定轉速）、體視顯微鏡（需配備 TR85 專用標線片）、灰色膜過濾器
blocks.en: Equipment needs: An orbital shaker (with settable speed), a stereomicroscope (equipped with the TR85 dedicated reticle), and gray membrane filters

blocks.zh: 人員訓練：分析人員需經過標線片使用訓練並通過資格認定
blocks.en: Personnel training: Analysts must be trained in the use of the reticle and pass a qualification

blocks.zh: SOP 整合：可將此方法整合到現有的進料品質管控 SOP 中
blocks.en: SOP integration: The method can be integrated into the existing incoming quality control SOP

blocks.zh: 供應商溝通：建議在品質協議中要求供應商也採用此方法，以實現數據可比性
blocks.en: Supplier communication: It is advisable to require in the quality agreement that the supplier also use this method, so that the data are comparable

blocks.zh: 為什麼選擇「灰色」濾膜而非「白色」或「黑色」？各有什麼優缺點？
blocks.en: Why choose a "gray" membrane rather than "white" or "black"? What are the advantages and disadvantages of each?

blocks.zh: 如果振盪時間從 20 秒改為 60 秒，可能會對結果產生什麼影響？
blocks.en: If the shaking time were changed from 20 seconds to 60 seconds, what effect might it have on the results?

blocks.zh: 4.3 Method Qualification Strategy and Lessons Learned 4.3 方法確效策略與經驗學習
blocks.en: 4.3 Method Qualification Strategy and Lessons Learned

blocks.zh: Attribute Agreement (屬性一致性): 一種統計方法，用於評估不同分析人員對同一樣本的判定結果是否一致。在微粒計數中，就是確認不同人用同樣的方法數出來的結果是否可比。
blocks.en: Attribute Agreement: A statistical method used to assess whether different analysts reach consistent decisions on the same sample. In particle counting, it confirms whether results counted by different people using the same method are comparable.

blocks.zh: Repeatability (重複性): 同一分析人員在相同條件下重複測試同一樣本，結果的一致程度。
blocks.en: Repeatability: The degree of agreement among results when the same analyst repeatedly tests the same sample under the same conditions.

blocks.zh: DOE (Design of Experiments, 實驗設計): 系統性地改變實驗條件以識別變異來源的統計方法。TR85 團隊透過 DOE 找出了導致計數變異的具體因素。
blocks.en: DOE (Design of Experiments): A statistical approach that systematically varies experimental conditions to identify sources of variation. The TR85 team used DOE to identify the specific factors causing count variability.

blocks.zh: Homogeneity (均勻性): 微粒在封蓋表面分佈的均勻程度。這是本方法面臨的最大挑戰之一 -- 微粒在包裝袋內的分佈天生就不均勻。
blocks.en: Homogeneity: The uniformity of the distribution of particles on the closure surface. This is one of the biggest challenges for this method: the distribution of particles within a package bag is inherently non-uniform.

blocks.zh: 想像你要訓練一組品酒師判斷紅酒的品質。理想情況下，你需要各種品質等級的酒讓他們練習。但如果你手上的酒幾乎都是頂級（微粒計數接近零），品酒師就沒辦法學會辨別差異。你嘗試自己「製造」劣質酒（人工接種微粒），但每瓶的品質都不一致。最後你發現：最好的訓練材料是「還沒經過最後精煉步驟」的酒（洗滌前的膠塞） -- 因為它們天然含有足夠的雜質讓品酒師練習辨別。
blocks.en: Imagine you need to train a group of sommeliers to judge wine quality. Ideally, you would give them wines of every quality grade to practice on. But if almost all the wine you have is top grade (particle counts close to zero), the sommeliers cannot learn to tell the difference. You try to "make" poor wine yourself (artificially spiking particles), but the quality of each bottle is inconsistent. In the end you find that the best training material is wine that has "not yet been through the final refining step" (stoppers before washing), because it naturally contains enough impurities for the sommeliers to practice discriminating.

blocks.zh: 三大經驗教訓：
blocks.en: Three major lessons learned:

blocks.zh: 訓練是關鍵：嚴格訓練 + 清晰 SOP + 專用標線片 = 大幅降低主觀性。這呼應了 GMP 中「人員資格」永遠是品質系統的基石。
blocks.en: Training is key: Rigorous training + clear SOPs + a dedicated reticle = greatly reduced subjectivity. This echoes the GMP principle that "personnel qualification" is always the cornerstone of the quality system.

blocks.zh: 微粒分佈不均是天性：同一包裝袋內的膠塞，微粒分佈本身就不均勻。搬運、取樣、運輸都會加劇這種不均勻性。這意味著單次取樣結果的代表性有限，需要適當的取樣策略。
blocks.en: Non-uniform particle distribution is natural: Even among stoppers in the same package bag, the particle distribution is itself non-uniform. Handling, sampling and transport all aggravate this non-uniformity. This means a single sampling result has limited representativeness, and an appropriate sampling strategy is needed.

blocks.zh: 人工接種失敗：試圖用碎橡膠片和纖維素乳液來模擬微粒負載，但因為分佈不均導致回收率高度變異。這告訴我們，真實世界的微粒分佈比我們想像的更複雜。
blocks.en: Artificial spiking failed: Attempts to simulate the particle burden with rubber fragments and cellulose emulsion produced highly variable recovery because of non-uniform distribution. This tells us that the real-world particle distribution is more complex than we imagine.

blocks.zh: 訓練材料的選擇策略：使用「清洗前」的膠塞作為訓練和確認材料是一個務實的解決方案。這些膠塞在製造後尚未經過藥用清洗步驟，自然攜帶足夠的微粒，能提供有意義的計數結果來進行統計評估。這比人工接種更可靠，因為微粒是自然存在的。
blocks.en: Strategy for choosing training material: Using "pre-wash" stoppers as training and qualification material is a pragmatic solution. These stoppers have not yet gone through the pharmaceutical washing step after manufacture and naturally carry enough particles to give meaningful counts for statistical evaluation. This is more reliable than artificial spiking, because the particles are naturally present.

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 要導入 TR85 方法，以下是方法確認的實務建議：
blocks.en: If your CDMO is going to implement the TR85 method, here are practical recommendations for method qualification:

blocks.zh: 訓練材料：向膠塞供應商索取「清洗前」的樣品用於訓練，不要用商業批次（計數太低）
blocks.en: Training material: Ask the stopper supplier for "pre-wash" samples for training; do not use commercial batches (counts are too low)

blocks.zh: 人員資格：設計屬性一致性測試 -- 讓多名分析人員互相檢視對方的濾膜樣品
blocks.en: Personnel qualification: Design an attribute agreement test, in which several analysts review each other's membrane filter samples

blocks.zh: 變異來源：建立取樣 SOP 時，考慮微粒分佈不均的問題，可能需要從包裝袋的不同位置取樣
blocks.en: Sources of variation: When establishing the sampling SOP, consider the problem of non-uniform particle distribution; it may be necessary to sample from different positions in the package bag

blocks.zh: DOE 驗證：使用 DOE 方法系統性地評估操作變數（振盪速度、沖洗次數等）對結果的影響
blocks.en: DOE verification: Use DOE to systematically evaluate the effect of operating variables (shaking speed, number of rinses, etc.) on the results

blocks.zh: 為什麼商業膠塞批次的微粒計數通常接近零？這對方法確認帶來什麼挑戰？
blocks.en: Why are particle counts in commercial stopper batches usually close to zero? What challenge does this pose for method qualification?

blocks.zh: 「搬運、取樣、運輸會加劇微粒分佈的不均勻性」-- 請解釋這個現象的物理機制。
blocks.en: "Handling, sampling and transport aggravate the non-uniformity of particle distribution": explain the physical mechanism behind this phenomenon.

blocks.zh: 如果你負責設計此方法的人員資格認定方案，你會設計怎樣的考核標準？
blocks.en: If you were responsible for designing the personnel qualification program for this method, what assessment criteria would you set?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 標準化的必要性：TR85 開發了增強型封蓋檢測方法，整合 USP <788> 與 ISO 8871-3 的優勢，讓供應商和藥廠能在相同基準上比較微粒數據
blocks.en: Need for standardization: TR85 developed an Enhanced Closures Testing Method that integrates the strengths of USP <788> and ISO 8871-3, allowing suppliers and pharmaceutical companies to compare particle data on the same basis

blocks.zh: 雙重尺寸閾值：等軸微粒（長寬比 <5）的可見閾值為 100 μm，纖維狀微粒（長寬比 ≥5）的可見閾值為 300 μm。100 μm 是保守選擇，低於 150 μm 的可靠檢出下限
blocks.en: Dual size thresholds: The visible threshold is 100 μm for equant particles (aspect ratio <5) and 300 μm for fibrous particles (aspect ratio ≥5). 100 μm is a conservative choice, below the 150 μm lower limit of reliable detection

blocks.zh: 創新標線片設計：圓形 (100 μm) + 長方形 (300 μm × 60 μm) 的標線片，將微粒尺寸「測量」簡化為「比較」，提升速度和一致性
blocks.en: Innovative reticle design: A reticle with a circle (100 μm) + a rectangle (300 μm × 60 μm) simplifies particle size "measurement" to "comparison", improving speed and consistency

blocks.zh: 標準化方法流程：表面積標準化取樣 → 界面活性劑沖洗 → 軌道振盪 20 秒 → 灰色膜過濾 → 重複 → 乾燥 → 標線片計數
blocks.en: Standardized method workflow: Surface-area-normalized sampling → surfactant rinse → 20-second orbital shaking → gray membrane filtration → repeat → drying → reticle counting

blocks.zh: 方法確認的經驗教訓：微粒分佈不均是主要變異來源；人工接種不實際；清洗前的膠塞是最佳訓練材料；嚴格訓練 + 標線片 = 降低主觀性
blocks.en: Lessons learned in method qualification: Non-uniform particle distribution is the main source of variability; artificial spiking is impractical; pre-wash stoppers are the best training material; rigorous training + reticle = reduced subjectivity

blocks.zh: 適用範圍注意：尺寸閾值僅適用於分析方法超越人眼時的組件測試，不適用於成品目視檢查
blocks.en: Note on scope: The size thresholds apply only to component testing where the analytical method exceeds the capability of the human eye, not to visual inspection of finished products
